# Conqueror Roadster 450 - Common Problems

The Conqueror Roadster 450 is an off-road/hybrid camper trailer popular in Australia and South Africa. Here are some commonly reported issues:

## Structural / Build Quality
- **Water leaks** – Seams and seals around the roof, windows, and tent connections can develop leaks over time
- **Weld cracking** – Stress cracks on the chassis or frame, particularly after heavy off-road use
- **Body panel fitment issues** – Gaps or misalignment reported on some units

## Tent & Canvas
- **Canvas wear and mildew** – The tent/canvas sections can develop mold if packed away damp
- **Zipper failures** – Zippers on tent sections may jam or break
- **Pole/frame issues** – Tent support mechanisms can bend or become difficult to operate

## Mechanical / Running Gear
- **Suspension issues** – Worn bushings or shock absorbers after rough terrain use
- **Bearing failures** – Wheel bearings may need regular repacking/replacement, especially after water crossings
- **Brake problems** – Electric brake wiring or adjustment issues

## Electrical
- **Wiring faults** – Connections can corrode or come loose, particularly after off-road travel
- **Battery/charging issues** – Solar or DC-DC charging systems may underperform

## Other
- **Weight concerns** – Can be heavy when fully loaded, affecting tow vehicle performance
- **Spare parts availability** – Depending on location, parts can be hard to source
- **Customer service complaints** – Some owners have reported slow warranty responses

## Tips
- **Regular maintenance** and inspections after off-road trips are essential
- **Dry canvas thoroughly** before packing away
- **Check all fasteners** and welds periodically
- Join owner forums/Facebook groups for model-specific advice

Would you like more detail on any specific issue?
